# SSS Super Speciality Hospital

> NABH-certified multi-speciality hospital in Erode, Tamil Nadu, India. Providing 24/7 emergency care, 24+ medical specialities, 29+ expert specialist doctors, and 150+ beds.

SSS Super Speciality Hospital is a tertiary healthcare institution in Erode, Tamil Nadu. Equipped with an AI-enabled 3D Cardiac Catheterization Lab (Cath Lab), 4 modern laminar airflow operation theatres, 150+ inpatient beds, 30-bed emergency & trauma unit, intensive care units (ICU, NICU), 24/7 dialysis center, and round-the-clock diagnostic laboratory and pharmacy. Winner of the Nalam Viruthugal 2025 Award for Best Emerging Hospital.

- **Accreditation**: NABH Certified (National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers)
- **Awards**: Nalam Viruthugal 2025 — Best Emerging Hospital
- **Address**: 167/2C1, Perundurai Road, Opp to SBI Bank, URC Nagar, Erode, Tamil Nadu 638009, India
- **General Enquiries**: 0424-2888777
- **Appointment Line**: +91 7729 888777
- **Emergency Helpline (24/7)**: +91 89259 31193
- **Email**: info@ssshospitals.in
- **Website**: [https://ssshospitals.in](https://ssshospitals.in)
- **Hours**: Open 24/7/365
- **Insurance**: CMCHIS and cashless from all major TPAs

## Optional

### Medical Specialities

- [Cardiology](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/cardiology): AI-enabled 3D Cath Lab, angiography, angioplasty, pacemaker, ECG, ECHO
- [Orthopaedics](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/orthopaedics): Knee/hip replacement, arthroscopy, sports injury, fracture care
- [Emergency Care](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/accident-emergency-care): 24/7 ER, trauma resuscitation, advanced life support ambulances
- [OB-GYN](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/obstetrics-gynaecology): Maternity care, painless delivery, high-risk pregnancy, laparoscopic surgery
- [Gastroenterology](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/gastroenterology): Endoscopy, colonoscopy, ERCP, liver disease
- [General Surgery](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/general-surgery): Laparoscopic surgery for hernia, gallbladder, piles, thyroid
- [Nephrology](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/nephrology): Kidney disease, CKD, 24/7 dialysis, transplant evaluation
- [Urology](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/urology): Kidney stones (PCNL, URS, RIRS), prostate, urinary tract
- [Neurology](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/neurology): Stroke care, epilepsy, migraine, Parkinson's, EEG, EMG
- [Neurosurgery](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/neuro-surgery): Brain tumour, spine surgery, head trauma
- [Paediatrics](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/paediatrics): Child specialist, NICU, vaccinations, growth screening
- [Dermatology](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/dermatology-cosmetology): Skin specialist, acne, eczema, laser therapy, PRP
- [ENT](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/ent-head-neck): Sinus surgery, tonsillectomy, hearing loss, vertigo
- [Internal Medicine](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/internal-medicine): Diabetes, hypertension, thyroid, infectious disease
- [Dental Surgery](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/dental-oral-and-maxillofacial-surgery): Implants, root canal, jaw surgery, cosmetic dentistry
- [Pulmonology](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/pulmonology): Asthma, COPD, pneumonia, sleep apnea, bronchoscopy
- [Ophthalmology](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/ophthalmology): Cataract surgery, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy
- [Plastic Surgery](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/plastic-surgery): Burns, hand surgery, microvascular, scar revision
- [Psychiatry](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/psychiatry): Depression, anxiety, OCD, bipolar, counseling
- [Physiotherapy](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/physiotherapy): Post-op rehab, neuro-rehab, stroke rehab, sports injury
- [Radiology](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/radiology): Digital X-ray, CT scan, 3D/4D ultrasound, Doppler
- [Anaesthesiology](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/anaesthesiology): Critical care, pain management, perioperative care
- [Vascular Surgery](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/vascular-surgery): Varicose veins laser, DVT, PAD, AV fistula
- [Master Health Checkup](https://ssshospitals.in/specialities/master-health-check-up): Preventive screening packages
